scenario.title: 驚喜派對、收禮物、稱讚
scenario.context: 派對上最常說的就是驚嘆：「好漂亮的蛋糕！」「你們也太用心了吧！」英文的感嘆句 What a… / How… 有固定結構，學會就能自然地表達驚喜和感謝，不用每次都說 very very good。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Oh my god, you guys! What a surprise!
lines.zh: 天啊，你們！也太驚喜了吧！

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: None at all! How did you get everyone here without me knowing?
lines.zh: 完全沒有！你們怎麼讓大家都來還不被我發現？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Leo told you we were just grabbing dinner, remember?
lines.zh: Leo 跟你說我們只是去吃晚餐，記得嗎？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I can't believe it. How sweet of you guys!
lines.zh: 我不敢相信，你們也太貼心了！

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: It was all Minz's idea. She planned the whole thing.
lines.zh: 全都是 Minz 的主意，她一手策劃的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Come here! What a great friend you are.

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: What a beautiful cake! Where did you get it?
lines.zh: 好漂亮的蛋糕！在哪買的？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: A little bakery in Da'an. The owner's a friend.
lines.zh: 大安區的一家小烘焙坊，老闆是朋友。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Who's that guy dancing on the sofa? I don't know him.
lines.zh: 那個在沙發上跳舞的是誰？我不認識他。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No idea. I think he's from the party next door. He just crashed ours.
lines.zh: 不知道，應該是隔壁派對的人，他直接混進我們的。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Ha! Well, he's definitely the life of the party.
lines.zh: 哈！嗯，他絕對是全場氣氛擔當。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: What a party animal. It's two a.m. and he's still going.
lines.zh: 真是派對動物，凌晨兩點了還在嗨。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Thank you all so much. How lucky am I to have friends like you?
lines.zh: 謝謝大家。我有你們這樣的朋友真是太幸運了。

patterns.note: How + 形容詞 + of you = 你真是…
收到禮物時的客套話，字面是「你不該這樣做的」
比較傳統的英式生日祝福

chinglish.right: What a beautiful cake! / How beautiful!
chinglish.why: 有名詞時用 What a + 形容詞 + 名詞；只有形容詞時用 How + 形容詞。How beautiful cake 把兩個結構混在一起了。

chinglish.right: Happy birthday! / Wishing you a happy birthday!
chinglish.why: 「祝你生日快樂」直翻少了主詞，還少了 a。直接說 Happy birthday 最自然。
中文可以疊字加強，英文要用 so much / so / really。
weather 不可數，不能用 a。不可數名詞的感嘆句是 What + 形容詞 + 名詞。

grammar.title: 感嘆句 What a… / How…
grammar.oneLiner: 有名詞用 What（a）…，只有形容詞或副詞用 How…
whenToUse: What a / an + (形容詞) + 單數可數名詞：What a surprise! / What an amazing cake!
What + (形容詞) + 複數或不可數名詞：What cute kids! / What nice weather!
How + 形容詞 / 副詞：How sweet! / How beautiful! / How fast he runs!
How + 形容詞 + of you：How kind of you! / How thoughtful of you!
後面可以接完整句子，但主詞動詞不倒裝：What a great friend you are!（不是 are you）
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的感嘆只要加「好、太、真」：「好漂亮」「好漂亮的蛋糕」，結構完全一樣。英文卻要看後面有沒有名詞，選 What 或 How。另外，英文感嘆句後面的主詞動詞不倒裝，台灣人受疑問句影響，常說出 What a nice girl is she!。

examples.correct: What a nice guy he is!
examples.incorrect: What a nice guy is he!

examples.correct: How thoughtful of you to remember my birthday!
examples.note: How + 形容詞 + of you + to V。

quiz.question: Which is correct?
quiz.explanation: weather 不可數，What + 形容詞 + 名詞。

quiz.question: Which is correct?
options: What a lucky guy are you!
What a lucky guy you are!
quiz.explanation: 感嘆句主詞動詞不倒裝。

slang.usage: 形容很愛參加派對、玩到很晚的人。

risk.note: 通常是開玩笑的稱呼；在正式場合介紹別人時別這樣說。

examples.en: My brother was a party animal in college.
I used to be a party animal. Now I'm in bed by ten.
examples.zh: 我以前很愛玩，現在十點就上床了。

slang.usage: throw 比 hold 更口語，throw someone a party = 幫某人辦派對。

examples.en: We're throwing a party for Leo's thirtieth.
examples.zh: 我們要幫 Leo 辦三十歲派對。

examples.en: Let's throw her a surprise party.
examples.zh: 我們幫她辦個驚喜派對吧。

slang.usage: 沒被邀請卻跑去參加。party crasher = 不速之客。

risk.note: 常帶玩笑語氣：Mind if I crash your party?（我可以來湊熱鬧嗎？）

examples.en: Some random guys crashed our party last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有幾個陌生人闖進我們的派對。

examples.en: Hope you don't mind me crashing your party!
examples.zh: 希望你不介意我來湊熱鬧！

slang.meaning: 派對的靈魂人物、氣氛擔當
slang.usage: 形容讓大家都很開心、帶動氣氛的人。

examples.en: Grandpa was the life of the party at the wedding.
examples.zh: 阿公是婚禮上的氣氛擔當。

examples.en: Invite Jess. She's always the life of the party.
examples.zh: 邀 Jess 啦，她每次都是全場焦點。

review.question: My laptop ___ last week. The screen looks new now.
review.explanation: 複習第 18 單元：被修理用被動。

review.question: Can I use your charger? My phone's almost ___.
review.explanation: 複習第 18 單元：dead = 沒電。

review.question: Which is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 17 單元：had better not。

review.question: I ___ ever drink coffee after 3 p.m. (幾乎不)
review.explanation: 複習第 15 單元：hardly ever = 幾乎不。

review.question: ___ a lot of people at the party last night.
review.explanation: 複習第 11 單元：複數過去用 There were。

review.question: The party is ___ Leo's apartment.
review.explanation: 複習第 3 單元：在某人家、某個地點用 at。

review.question: You bring a gift. Your friend says: "___"
review.explanation: You shouldn't have! = 你太破費了。
